{{Quote|He goes by the name of Drune Juntura and he operates out of Mos Eisley.|Zekka Thyne|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Drune Juntura''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Zekka Thyne (Bothan)|Zekka Thyne]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him before he could reach the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Drune Juntura]]
Drune Juntura was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
